title: A Grothendieck spectral sequence for two specialization-stable supports and the composition of the associated derived functors
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement constructs the spectral sequence whose E_2 page is the local cohomology with support in one specialization-stable subset applied to the local cohomology with support in another, converging to the local cohomology with support in the intersection, for bounded below complexes (author lemma at source lines 1130-1140, label lemma-local-cohomology-ss). The proof (source lines 1142-1160) does not invoke the general Grothendieck sequence blindly: it first identifies the composite functor by adjointness through a displayed sequence of Hom equalities (proof lines 1143-1150), then verifies by an injective resolution that the composite is computed by the iterated zeroth local cohomology and lands in the category of modules supported in the intersection (proof lines 1151-1157), and only then invokes the general spectral sequence lemma. The two identifications are the content. H2.
